summary: The simulation runs and includes many core elements, but it still diverges from the specification in key metrics and behaviors. The most critical issues are sticky adoption (de-adoption impossible), missing compliance-by-location and cost/fine metrics, and lack of validation checks (convergence, S-curve, policy sensitivity). There are also performance inefficiencies (O(N^2) workplace scan) and a few logic inconsistencies (unused trust delta, enforcement probability not using the Government field). This feedback provides targeted fixes, model improvements, and code-level changes with before/after snippets to align with the task specification and improve realism and performance.

critical_issues.impact: Mask use can only stay the same or increase (except for inventory constraints), eliminating fatigue-driven declines and biasing sustained adoption upwards. This breaks realistic dynamics and validation checks (e.g., convergence, S-curve).
critical_issues.solution: Remove the 'or self.current_mask_use' in Individual.evaluate_mask_use_decision and rely on habit_strength and decay to model persistence. Sample adoption afresh each step.

critical_issues.issue: Missing key metrics: compliance_by_location_type, average_fines_per_capita, average_out_of_pocket_cost, sustained_adoption (final 14 days)
critical_issues.impact: Cannot evaluate against the specification or conduct policy analysis involving fines and affordability. Reduces usefulness of outputs for decision-making.
critical_issues.solution: Track per-visit compliance by location type, per-person fine counts, and per-person cumulative spending. Compute sustained_adoption over the last 14 days.

critical_issues.issue: Enforcement probability uses cfg value instead of Government.enforcement_probability
critical_issues.impact: Adjustments to enforcement via Government are ignored; this breaks policy response sensitivity and dynamic scenarios.
critical_issues.solution: Replace cfg['enforcement_probability'] with self.government.enforcement_probability at all enforcement decision points.

critical_issues.issue: Media trust delta from broadcast is computed but not applied
critical_issues.impact: Media effects on trust are inconsistent; reduces fidelity of media dynamics and undermines calibration.
critical_issues.solution: Apply dt_global to agents (e.g., add to trust_in_authority after per-agent consume_media_messages).

critical_issues.issue: Performance hotspot: per-agent workplace compliance estimate scans the whole population
critical_issues.impact: O(N^2) time per day at larger populations; will not scale to spec population sizes (e.g., 5,000).
critical_issues.solution: Precompute workplace member lists once in initialize and reuse them in step for O(1) access.

critical_issues.issue: Validation criteria not implemented (convergence_check, S-curve, policy_response_sensitivity)
critical_issues.impact: Cannot verify whether the simulation is behaving plausibly under baseline and policy variation; reduces credibility.
critical_issues.solution: Add a validate() routine (re-introduce a simplified, faster version) or compute validation metrics in evaluate: check last-7-day trend below threshold, curvature pattern for S-curve, and monotonic increase under stronger policy.

critical_issues.impact: Overcounts shortage days, biasing supply-chain metrics.
critical_issues.solution: Exclude the first series element in mask shortage computations or track per-step booleans.

model_improvements.current_approach: Decision returns rng.random() < prob or self.current_mask_use, making adoption sticky.
model_improvements.suggested_approach: Use a pure probabilistic update (rng.random() < prob) and model persistence via habit_strength formation/decay; optionally add a fatigue term that reduces prob when mandates persist or under repeated enforced compliance.
model_improvements.expected_benefit: Allows de-adoption and realistic plateaus/declines; supports convergence and S-curve validation.

model_improvements.current_approach: Enforcement improves compliance_propensity; no fines tracked or costs applied.
model_improvements.suggested_approach: Add per-agent fines_count and total fines. Apply compliance boost via fine_effect_on_future_compliance parameter; report average_fines_per_capita.
model_improvements.expected_benefit: Enables analysis of enforcement tradeoffs and aligns with spec metrics.

model_improvements.current_approach: Purchases change mask_inventory but do not track spending.
model_improvements.suggested_approach: Track cumulative_spend per agent when purchasing. Report average_out_of_pocket_cost and explore price elasticity effects by group.
model_improvements.expected_benefit: Improves realism and supports economic impact analysis and calibration.

model_improvements.current_approach: Per-visit enforcement without a compliance breakdown by location type.
model_improvements.suggested_approach: Maintain visits_total_by_type and visits_compliant_by_type and compute compliance_by_location_type.
model_improvements.expected_benefit: Enables targeted policy evaluation by setting (transit/workplace/retail).

model_improvements.current_approach: No formal checks for convergence, diffusion pattern, or policy sensitivity.
model_improvements.suggested_approach: Add evaluate-time or validate() checks: last-7-day change < 0.01; S-curve via acceleration sign change; sensitivity via monotonic effect of policy_strength/enforcement_probability on adoption.
model_improvements.expected_benefit: Ensures simulation plausibility and makes debugging regressions easier.

code_improvements.modification: Remove sticky adoption (drop 'or self.current_mask_use' from Individual.evaluate_mask_use_decision).
code_improvements.reason: Allows de-adoption and realistic dynamics; fixes major logic bug.

code_improvements.modification: Track fines and spending: add Individual.fines_count, Individual.cumulative_spend; increment on enforcement and purchase; add average_fines_per_capita and average_out_of_pocket_cost in evaluate.
code_improvements.reason: Implements required spec metrics and enables cost analyses.

code_improvements.modification: Use self.government.enforcement_probability in step for enforcement checks.
code_improvements.reason: Supports dynamic policy changes and sensitivity validation.

code_improvements.modification: Apply dt_global to trust updates after consume_media_messages.
code_improvements.reason: Fixes inconsistency: broadcast trust delta was unused.

code_improvements.modification: Precompute workers_by_wp mapping in initialize; reuse in step for workplace local rate instead of scanning the whole population.
code_improvements.reason: Eliminates O(N^2) per-day behavior; scales to larger populations.

code_improvements.modification: Add per-type compliance counters visits_total_by_type and visits_compliant_by_type; compute compliance_by_location_type in evaluate.
code_improvements.reason: Implements a required metric and supports policy analysis by location.

code_improvements.modification: Compute sustained_adoption over final 14 days; exclude the initial pre-step element when computing mask_shortage_days and stockout_rate.
code_improvements.reason: Aligns with spec and fixes bias introduced by initial-value logging.

code_improvements.modification: Add simple validation checks (convergence_check, s_curve_diffusion_pattern, policy_response_sensitivity) in a validate() method or in evaluate as extra outputs if requested.
code_improvements.reason: Meets validation criteria and provides guardrails.

code_improvements.modification: Remove unused imports (argparse, shutil, sys) and dead code Retailer.sell_masks_to_individuals or integrate it.

data_alignment_suggestions.current_gap: Potentially too monotonic/increasing due to sticky adoption and weak fatigue; may not show realistic plateaus or declines.
data_alignment_suggestions.suggestion: Implement reversible adoption with habit and fatigue; calibrate habit_formation_rate and habit_decay_rate to match observed adoption curves. Optionally introduce a mild fatigue_rate that reduces habit under prolonged mandates.

data_alignment_suggestions.current_gap: Not computed; cannot compare with observed compliance in specific settings (e.g., public transit vs retail).
data_alignment_suggestions.suggestion: Track per-visit compliance by loc_type and compare to observed compliance surveys by setting; tune enforcement_strictness and signage_strength.

data_alignment_suggestions.current_gap: Not computed; no calibration to real spending patterns.
data_alignment_suggestions.suggestion: Track cumulative_spend and calibrate price_elasticity_of_demand and affordability_threshold by income group against observed purchase/usage rates.

data_alignment_suggestions.current_gap: No validation; unknown monotonicity of policy effects.
data_alignment_suggestions.suggestion: Include a quick A/B test in validate() that increases enforcement_probability and/or mandate coverage and verifies adoption increases weakly.

prioritized_actions: Fix sticky adoption by changing the decision return to rng.random() < prob and rely on habit for persistence.
Add fines and spending tracking; implement average_fines_per_capita and average_out_of_pocket_cost.
Implement per-type compliance counters and the compliance_by_location_type metric.
Use Government.enforcement_probability in enforcement checks; apply dt_global to trust.
Precompute workplace member lists to eliminate O(N^2) behavior.
Adjust sustained_adoption to last 14 days; exclude initial element for mask_shortage_days/stockout_rate.
Add validation checks for convergence, S-curve, and policy sensitivity.
Clean up unused imports and remove or integrate dead Retailer.sell_masks_to_individuals.
additional_comments: The recent iteration substantially improved realism (locations, visibility, media with misinformation, affordability, homophily). The next step is aligning with spec-required metrics and ensuring de-adoption is possible. Once the validation harness is in place, you can iteratively tune parameters (habit rates, enforcement, media) to achieve an S-shaped diffusion under baseline and sensitivity under policy strengthening.

change_analysis.summary: The latest iteration improves realism and configurability (locations, media with misinformation, affordability, visibility, homophily, habit). However, some spec-required metrics and validations are still missing, and a few regressions were introduced (unused media trust delta, enforcement probability not using Government field).

Added misinformation and affordability dynamics with price elasticity.
Added habit formation/decay and weekly activity patterns.

Enforcement probability uses cfg instead of Government.enforcement_probability.
mask_shortage_days counts include an initial pre-step element.
Performance hotspot in workplace compliance estimation remains.
